description: Search a SNAPSHOT of public contractor-licence data for one state: CA (CSLB), TX (TDLR contractors), FL (DBPR construction and electrical) or WA (L&I contractors). Give license_number, business_name (3+ characters), zip and/or county (CA, TX, FL; not WA); city narrows. limit 1-10. live_active_verified is always false -- confirm at the verify_url in every answer. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. States accepted: CA, TX, FL, WA; loaded now: CA, FL, TX, WA. A state not loaded yet answers state_unavailable.
name: search_contractor_license_snapshot
